sec.title: September 2 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 640)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 2** across six decades of prestigious full-length radio drama productions on BBC's flagship *Saturday Night Theatre* series (1950, 1961, 1967, 1972, 1978, 1995), Michael Pertwee, Henry Cecil, Arthur Swinson, Fritz Hochwälder, Lillian de la Torre (Timothy West as Dr. Johnson), and Chinua Achebe (1950–1995):
